name: Glow
description: Draws a soft colored aura around the currently focused window rounds the corners of every window, 12px on all four, and gives Alt+Tab large previews laid in rows. Works with any application — GTK, Electron, Qt, SWT — because it runs at the compositor level. On laptops it also shows a battery icon in the style of Windows 11, the remaining time on hover, and a compact free-space indicator. Everything is configurable in extension.js.
